description: Installation of three air conditioning units.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Location plan dated 10/11/2024, PL 001 A, PL 002 A, PL 003 A, PL 004 A, Design and Access Statement by Novispace dated November 2024, Noise Impact Assessment by Jostec ref. 24660 dated 06/11/2024, TM59 Thermal Analysis ref. 24660 version TA2 dated 10/04/2025.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, or by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 4 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration-isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - Prior to use of the air conditioning units hereby permitted, evidence shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating that the installed system achieves a minimum SEER of 5.1 and utilises low global warming potential refrigerants (GWP < 675 or equivalent low-GWP alternatives); the development has reduced cooling demand as far as possible; and that the cooling hierarchy has been followed and all feasible measures implemented.

Reason: To ensure that development reduces the impact of urban and dwelling overheating, including application of the cooling hierarchy, in accordance with policy CC2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan.
Condition : 6 - Active cooling shall be restricted to the rooms identified as at risk of overheating within the overheating assessment titled TM59 Thermal Analysis ref. 24660 version TA2 dated 10/04/2025, namely, the bedroom at 2nd floor and the bedroom at 3rd floor level. 

Reason: To ensure that development reduces the impact of urban and dwelling overheating, including application of the cooling hierarchy, in accordance with policy CC2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan.
subdivision_of_building: Roof level and rear ground floor only
